notes.title: Release Notes - Version 1.3.0 (June 2024)
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your patience as we prepare for a major content release.
In the meantime, enjoy our newest update: Tenno v1.3.0.

Here’s a list of all the changes:

+ Fixed "Kinjutsu: Skeletal Impale" CD
+ Added New Packages
+ Fixed Push Notifications.
+ Fixed "Orbs of Gaiat Tengu Back Item".
+ Fixed Solo Adventure Stamina Text.
+ Brand New Tenno Pass Season 1.
+ Added 20 New Effects—more info on our **WIKI **.
+ Fixed Debuff Resist Bug.
+ Changed in-battle Username Font.
+ New Mission Chapter.
+ Improved the Agility and Skill-Bar System.
+ Improved Monthly Login Design.
+ Increased Status Effects disappear timer.
+ New Level 40 Hunting House Bosses.
+ Added Item Details feature—view item information by long-clicking or pressing and holding the item icon.
+ Added the ability to purchase Tenno Pass levels.
+ Fixed Target Selection Marker.
+ Improved Loading Screen when connecting to server.
+ Fixed Shadow Realm Package.
+ Fixed Snow VFX on Water Village.
+ Remember Last Village Upon Restart.
+ New Armor Effects mechanics.
+ Fixed a bug where the game would continue if the player was dead but had recruits in the game.
+ You can now favorite your friends in the game to make them easier to find—they will always show up first.
+ Chests can now be opened/purchased in bulk.
+ Fixed Package Icons on the confirmation screen.
+ Added New Hunting House Rewards for all new bosses.
+ Fixed Facebook Login.
+ Added June Login Rewards.
+ Fixed Status Effects Display.
+ Chest Rewards on storyline missions.
+ Improved the description/name for some items containing typos.
+ Added notification for when a player cannot charge or use normal attacks.
+ Increased Rewards for Hunting House (GOLD, XP).
+ Fixed Solo Adventure NPC Colors.

This update is a preparation for something much bigger to come. 
We are excited about the future of Tenno, and once again, thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Release Notes - Version 1.1.5 (February 2024)
notes.content:
Valentine Event
Engage in thrilling alliance-based competition in our latest event.
Team up with allies to take on five new bosses across various difficulties, earning rewards based on your earned points and your ranking.

New Storyline Chapter
Embark on a new chapter in the mission room, delving into the Tenno Ninja Exams where formidable adversaries await your challenge.

Fresh Deals
Explore a range of new deals in the shop, with more enticing offers scheduled throughout February.

Burn Effect Adjustment
The burn effect now scales with maximum HP, providing a more balanced gameplay experience.

Enhanced Security
We've bolstered game security measures for a safer gaming environment.

Android Logo Fix
Resolved an issue with the Android logo display.

Improved Skillbar System
Enjoy smoother navigation and interaction with our revamped skillbar system.

Boss Balancing
Tweaked difficulty levels for hunting house bosses.

Achievements
Unlock new milestones and track your progress with the addition of achievements.

Package System Enhancement
We've refined the package system for improved functionality.

Discord Rich Presence Fix
Fixed a bug affecting Discord's rich presence feature.

Damage Balancing
Adjusted random damage between attacks to skew more favorably towards players.

Player Body Display Fix
Rectified inconsistencies in player body appearance across different devices.

Multiplayer System Update
Experience smoother multiplayer interactions with our updated system.

In-App Purchase Bug Fix
Addressed a bug related to in-app purchases for seamless transactions.

We hope these updates enhance your gaming experience.
As always, we appreciate your support and feedback.
